verdict.rationale: Warp's own Agent handles onboarding and tax notices and asks the founder when a decision is theirs. It also runs default jobs when something happens and handles tax registrations automatically across all 50 states, which suggests it proactively deals with obligations from new hires and new locations. The evidence never describes explicit compliance-obligation alerts, and webhooks are generic data-change callbacks rather than compliance alerting. Missing for 10: documented alerts tied to new hires or new work locations creating obligations, any law-change monitoring or alerting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
